messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed console billing shows org X consuming project Y quota for a batch of inference calls.
akshay: huh. reproducer? any pattern on key type (org vs project vs sa)? :thinking:
sam: saw this earlier during load test, seemed tied to requests routed through the proxy fallback path.
jen: do we have logs/trace id for one of those calls? if it went fallback we should see auth.decision -> route.fallback in the trace.
maria: yes, got one. log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T14:02:03Z] trace=tr_0xabc auth.decide subject=org:123 key_kind=org_key route=primary fail_reason=quota_exceeded fallback=project:456
[2026-03-18T14:02:03Z] trace=tr_0xabc route.apply target=project:456 billing_account=proj-456
```
akshay: that looks like the code path where the router tries the cheaper org pool then falls back to project pool. bug might be we don't tag the final billing attribution with original_subject or effective_subject.
sam: right now console reads billing_account from route.apply target and shows that in UI. if fallback happens we should show both original requester and effective executor.
jen: we also need the telemetry k/v to include fields: auth_origin, route_decision, fallback_chain, trace_id. ops-bot can we surface an alert when fallback_rate > 0.5%?
ops-bot: created alert:eng.platform/fallback-rate-high threshold=0.5% window=1m owner=eng-platform
maria: perfect. For short-term mitigation can we change router to attach header X-EFFECTIVE-IDENTITY and X-REQUESTOR-ID so downstream billing can decide correctly?
akshay: quick patch in router is doable. risk: header propagation for internal pools only, must not leak to external services. will open PR with tests.
sam: also add console UX change: show "Effective executor (may differ from requester)" tooltip and expose fallback chain in the request details page.
jen: rollout plan? canary 5% traffic for 24h, monitor fallback-rate, billing-ops, and latency. I can own the canary config on the console side.
akshay: assigning myself for router patch, will link PR in thread. Expecting to cut branch and ship canary by EOD tomorrow.
maria: ops-bot — when canary starts, post a message here with canary tag so we can correlate traces.
ops-bot: will post canary events to thread when toggle is flipped.
jen: follow-up item: add unit test asserting that when fallback happens, telemetry includes "effective_subject" and console ingestion maps billing to effective_subject only if header present.
maria: agree. also add a migration job to reconcile past misattributed billing for last 7 days (estimate 0.7% of requests affected).
akshay: noted. will pair with finance for reconciliation plan.
sam: small note — please keep the log format stable (don't change field names) so existing dashboards don't break.
jen: thanks all — I'll draft a short postmortem-lite and UX mock for console tooltips. tagging @billing-team for visibility.
maria: thanks. :thumbsup:
